name: SEO brief survives backward and forward navigation
description: A business owner can enter search context, revisit the services step, and reach confirmation without re-entering the SEO brief.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /onboard/ and choose Enter details manually
Fill the required Business fields with fictional data: business Visual QA Plumbing, contact Alex, email alex@example.com, phone (555) 555-0100, and address 100 Test Street, Tacoma, WA 98402
Continue to Services, enter Drain cleaning as the core service, Tacoma as the area served, and Clear explanations as the differentiator

Continue to Search language, enter Drain cleaning as priority service, drain cleaning tacoma as a search phrase, Sink backs up after dishwasher runs as customer problem language, Septic pumping under exclusions, and Tacoma under priority locations
Use Back to return to Services, then Continue to Search language again
The Search language step still contains the previously entered priority service, search phrase, customer problem, exclusion, and priority location
Continue to Brand, enter leads@example.com as lead notification email, then continue to Confirm
The Confirm step displays a structured summary containing Drain cleaning, drain cleaning tacoma, Tacoma, the customer problem language, and Septic pumping
